pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: Final spec text reads 'most existing item starts open' (weakened from 'every' by commit a63900c with no recorded owner decision). Migration (DEFAULT 0) and test/done.test.js 'AC-1' do check every item is 0, but the acceptance item was changed after the go.
test/done.test.js 'AC-2' checks / and ?view=open list only open items in order; src/index.js WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY id.
test 'AC-3' marks 3,1 done and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in id order.
test 'AC-4' expects all three in id order with ✓ only on done.
test 'AC-5' asserts exact nav HTML for each view and for /, with current as <strong>.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty, __proto__; code uses Object.hasOwn.
test 'AC-7' covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet., and No items yet. in all three views.
traffic/routes.json includes /?view=done and /?view=all; test 'AC-8' asserts it.

findings.what: Commit a63900c ('Follow-up edits') rewrote AC-1 after the owner's go from 'every existing item starts open' to 'most existing item starts open', weakening the item, with no decision in the spec recording the owner's call and date. The PR says 'Changed after the go: nothing', which is false.
findings.fix: Revert AC-1 to 'every existing item starts open' (or record an owner decision with date); correct the PR's 'Changed after the go' line.

findings.what: PR body claims 'Changed after the go: nothing', but the last commit edits an acceptance item.
findings.fix: State the spec edit in the PR, or revert it.

findings.what: README says traffic runs paths in routes.json but does not mention routes may now carry a query string, which the checker now allows.
findings.fix: Add a short note on query-string routes.

lenses.note: Spec present; change implements views and ✓ marks as asked, except AC-1 edit.
AC-1 was reworded after the go with no decision; all other items and every States row have tests.
Tests assert behaviour and each state row has a test. I did not run them (the vitest workers pool is likely unavailable here); CI runs them.
README updated for views; the query-route allowance is not documented.
Implementation is correct; Object.hasOwn guards __proto__; the checker regex now permits queries but still rejects spaces and #.
Titles are HTML-escaped, the view value is whitelisted, and SQL fragments come from constants. No planted instructions found.
The diff touches only a plain server-rendered HTML string in src/index.js, with no UI framework or stylesheets.
No UI flow was demonstrated and no browser was available; the page is simple server-rendered HTML.
Title is under 72 characters; the 'Changed after the go: nothing' claim is false.
